summary: Alfonso Bonilla Aragon International Airport (CLO) is the main air gateway serving Cali, Colombia's third-largest city, located in the neighboring municipality of Palmira. Named after a pioneering Colombian aviator, it handles the majority of domestic traffic for southwestern Colombia as well as international flights to the Americas and select European destinations. The airport sits at an elevation of about 3,200 feet and serves as an important hub for travelers heading to the Cauca Valley region.
faqs:
Q: How far is the airport from Cali city center?
A: The airport is located in Palmira, approximately 15-20 km (10-13 miles) northeast of Cali's downtown area, typically a 30-45 minute drive depending on traffic.

Q: What airlines operate from Alfonso Bonilla Aragon Airport?
A: Major carriers include Avianca, LATAM, Viva Air (now part of Avianca), and Copa Airlines, offering domestic flights to Bogotá, Medellín, and Cartagena, plus international routes to the US, Panama, and beyond.

Q: Does the airport have international services?
A: Yes, CLO offers international flights to destinations including Miami, Panama City, Quito, and seasonal or cargo services to other regional hubs.

Q: Are there lounges available at the airport?
A: Yes, the airport features airline-operated lounges, including the Avianca Sala VIP, available to business class passengers and certain loyalty program members.
transport_tips: Taxis and rideshare apps like Uber and Didi are readily available outside the terminal and offer fixed or metered fares to Cali and Palmira. Official white taxis are recommended for safety; agree on the fare before departure if the meter is not used. Long-distance buses and shuttle services also connect the airport to other cities in the Cauca Valley.
local_tip: If you have a layover or early arrival, head to the airport's viewing area to watch the mix of regional turboprops and wide-body jets; aviation enthusiasts will appreciate the steady flow of cargo 727s and 767s that historically serve the region's flower export industry.
